channel.title: Caribbean National Weekly - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Caribbean National Weekly (caribbeannationalweekly.com)

item.title: Guyana Opposition leader seeks CCJ intervention to halt extradition to the US - CNW Network
item.description: Guyana's Azruddin Mohamed has filed an urgent application with CCJ seeking special leave to appeal last week’s ruling.

item.title: Jamaican priest aentenced to 12 years for sexual offences against minor - CNW Network
item.description: A 41-year-old Catholic priest was sentenced to 12 years in prison after being found guilty of having sexual intercourse with a minor.

item.title: Hard Rock Heals Foundation raises JMD$62 million for Jamaica's hurricane recovery - CNW Network
item.description: The Hard Rock Heals Foundation, the charitable arm of Hard Rock International, has raised US$400,000 (J$62.8 million) to support Jamaica.

item.title: UN report warns of expanding gang control and excessive force in Haiti - CNW Network
item.description: Deadly gangs in Haiti are extending their influence over critical sea and road routes, according to a new UN human rights report.

item.title: Audrey Marks to receive President’s Award at Right Now for Jamaica inaugural gala - CNW Network
item.description: The Honorable Audrey Marks will be honored with the inaugural President’s Award by Right Now for Jamaica's first-ever Gala Dinner &amp; Concert.

item.title: Alyssa James soars! Jamaican teen breaks into world’s top 50 - CNW Network
item.description: At just 18, Alyssa James is no longer simply a promising junior, she is rapidly becoming one of Jamaica’s most formidable tennis talents.

item.title: Busby backs versatile Reggae Girlz ahead of qualifiers - CNW Network
item.description: With qualification within reach, the Jamaica women's national football team enter the decisive phase of the Concacaf Qualifiers in a position of strength.

item.title: Lewis back in the fold as Red Force make tough selection calls - CNW Network
item.description: Trinidad and Tobago Red Force have turned to experience, recalling veteran opener Evin Lewis for the upcoming West Indies Championship.

item.title: Bicknell rockets up ITF rankings after Las Vegas triumph - CNW Network
item.description: Jamaica’s top tennis talent, Blaise Bicknell, showcased his growing dominance on the ITF circuit this past weekend.

item.title: T&T battle back but fall to Gabon in dramatic penalty showdown - CNW Network
item.description: Trinidad and Tobago’s FIFA Series campaign ended in disappointment on Monday in Tashkent, as they were eliminated by Gabon.

item.title: Bahamas PM announces May 12 general election, Parliament to be dissolved April 8 - CNW Network
item.description: Prime Minister Philip Davis has announced that The Bahamas will hold its next general election on May 12, 2026.

item.title: Haitian-American Coral Springs Vice Mayor Nancy Metayer Bowen shot and killed - CNW Network
item.description: Haitian-American Coral Springs Vice Mayor Nancy Metayer Bowen was shot and killed Wednesday in an apparent domestic violence incident.

item.title: Family of slain Coral Springs Vice Mayor Nancy Metayer Bowen issues statement - CNW Network
item.description: The family of slain Coral Springs Vice Mayor Nancy Metayer Bowen has issued a heartfelt statement following her death.

item.title: GraceKennedy Foundation featured on CBS series The Visioneers with Zay Harding - CNW Network
item.description: The GraceKennedy Foundation is celebrating international exposure after two appearances on the CBS television series The Visioneers.

item.title: Masicka’s ‘Whites’ soundtracks DR Congo’s historic World Cup qualification - CNW Network
item.description: Jamaica’s dream of returning to football’s biggest stage came to a halt — but Masicka became the soundtrack for the celebrations for DR Congo.
